Overhead crane swings heavy cargo across the hangar from upper-right, silhouetted against blazing bay-lights.
Cockpit canopy lifts open with a hydraulic hiss, vapor venting as the pilot begins climbing in.
Hangar-doors creak apart in the background, revealing pale dawn sky beyond, dust sweeping across the deck.
First-flight engines ignite at the mech-thruster array, glow brightening fast, vapor billowing in great white sheets.
Mech-eyes flicker online for the first time this scene, cyan-blue power-up glow building steadily behind the lenses.
Battlefield-rumble rolls overhead, dust cascading from the hangar roof in long curtains from a nearby concussion blast.
An engineer rappels down via gantry-cable carrying a heavy tool-kit, mid-descent across the mech's broad chest.
Missile-loaders wheel a full warhead rack into position beneath the mech's shoulder pylons, crew guiding carefully.
Fuel-line disconnects at the refuel-port with a hiss, last drops dripping as the hose coils back automatically.
A single armor-panel descends slowly from an overhead crane, swinging toward the mech's unpainted shoulder joint.
Deck-crew signal launch with batons crossed high overhead, the mech beginning its first slow forward lean.
Hangar-alarm strobe activates, red light beginning to wash rhythmically across the entire deck — deployment imminent.
Launch-catapult tensions beneath the mech's feet, rails locking in with a deep resonant mechanical click below.
Chest-port hatch blows open, venting a pressurized steam column outward — emergency-release equalization, pressure dropping fast.
Tech-lead shouts into a handheld radio standing at the mech's foot, gesturing urgently up toward its head.
Warning-printer spews a long ribbon of diagnostic paper at the maintenance-console, operator scrambling to read the readout.
Ammo-belt feeds into the shoulder-cannon mid-load, belt arching dramatically down from the overhead ammunition hoist above.
Floor-panel retracts beneath the mech's feet, revealing the launch-shaft below as the mech begins sinking into deployment.
A welding-cart gets pushed clear of the deck in a hurry, wheels squeaking, deck-crew jogging urgently aside.
Hangar-lights drop from white to deep red, deployment-state alert flooding the bay as all hands move to stations.
Crew hustles rapidly down gantry-ladders away from the mech on both sides, clearing the frame ahead of power-up.
Cockpit display-screens cycle on one by one inside the canopy, each panel blooming blue-cyan in sequence.
The hangar-door shadow sweeps slowly across the mech as the great doors slide, a light-bar climbing its chest.
A scrap-cart overturns in the midground, debris spilling wide across the deck, a tech leaping clear in time.
Blast-doors seal the bay with a reverberating hydraulic thud, locking the chamber tight for full engine-test ignition.
